subject: Finding a global overlap for technical deep dive (SE + architects)
messages:
From: Sara Malone <sara.malone@asterbio.com>

Date: 2026-10-28T13:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Deep dive — coordinating across US/EU/APAC

Hi Soojin and Marissa,

Thanks again for the overview last week. The architects on our side (US, Poland, and Singapore) want a technical deep dive focused on inference throughput, KV cache behavior, and private deployment network topology.

The tricky bit: we have people in EST (US East), CET, and SGT — and the team is worried about daylight savings changes at the end of October / start of November shifting windows. Can we find a 60–90 minute slot that works for a core group (SE + 3 customer architects)?

High-level availability from our side:
- Sara (US East): mornings 09:00–12:00 EDT most days
- Tomasz (Poland, CET): 14:00–18:00 CET (afternoons)
- Wei (Singapore, SGT): 09:00–11:30 SGT

I can try to pull calendar invites but wanted to coordinate before sending anything. If you can propose a small set of UTC slots (and note the local equivalents) that would be great.

Attached: a quick list of the architects and their preferred windows (see attachment: overlap_matrix.xlsx) — I've included buffer times for pre-call sync.

Best,
Sara Malone
Head of Platform Engineering — Aster Biotech
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: overlap_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deep dive — coordinating across US/EU/APAC

Sara — thanks for the matrix and the clear availability. Rafael and I talked about this and we think the cleanest way to avoid DST confusion is to propose slots in UTC and include local equivalents in the invite. Quick proposals:

Option A (early UTC): 13:00–14:30 UTC — local: 09:00–10:30 EDT / 14:00–15:30 CET / 22:00–23:30 SGT
Option B (late UTC): 15:00–16:30 UTC — local: 11:00–12:30 EDT / 16:00–17:30 CET / 00:00–01:30 SGT (next day for SGT)
Option C (compromise, shorter overlap): 12:00–13:30 UTC — local: 08:00–09:30 EDT / 13:00–14:30 CET / 21:00–22:30 SGT

Notes:
- We recommend Option A or C — avoids scheduling in the SGT late-night window.
- Marissa (SE) will do a 90-minute technical walkthrough with a short 15-minute pre-call for STAGING/access checks (we can do that 30 minutes prior).
- We'll attach an overlap matrix (I updated a couple of rows) — see attached.

I'll wait for Tomasz/Sara to confirm which option fits all three architects, then Marissa will send an agenda. Rafael, FYI — this is heating up toward evaluation; tagging you for any pricing/exec ask.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Malone <sara.malone@asterbio.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Deep dive — coordinating across US/EU/APAC

Hi all — quick technical notes to help pick the slot:

1) For the KV cache walkthrough we'll want the call to include: one architect with access to the customer pre-prod, one network/security architect, and one SE (that's me).
2) We plan a 20–30 minute demo of real requests (service account will be required) — please ensure at least one customer attendee can share terminal/console access or we can screen-share.
3) If we do Option C (12:00–13:30 UTC), we can run the demo toward the midpoint so it aligns with both CET afternoon and SGT evening. If Option A is chosen, we'll run the demo earlier in the slot to avoid SGT late-night fatigue.

A couple of practical items:
- Because of the DST transitions, use fixed UTC times in the calendar. In the invite body we will list local equivalents and note the DST status (e.g., "EST currently observing DST; CET switches on ...") — but we should avoid ambiguous phrasing like "next Friday morning."
- Can someone confirm whether SGT attendees prefer 90 minutes or 60 minutes? I can shorten to 60 if that helps attendance.

Proposed tentative agenda (90m):
- 0–5m: quick intros and objectives
- 5–25m: architecture + network constraints (customer)
- 25–55m: live inference demo + KV cache walkthrough (SE-led)
- 55–75m: quantization/throughput tuning and kernel-level Q&A
- 75–90m: next steps & action items (rollout checklist, staging access)

If you confirm the slot I'll attach a short tech prep doc and the access checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tomasz Kowalski <tomasz.kowalski@asterbio.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Malone <sara.malone@asterbio.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:10:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Deep dive — coordinating across US/EU/APAC

Thanks — we discussed internally. Quick replies:

- We prefer Option A (13:00–14:30 UTC) — it hits our CET afternoon and Sara's US morning, and Wei in SGT can stay late for this one (he confirmed availability today).
- 90 minutes works for the architects.
- Aster security requires the pre-call checklist for service account access; please send the checklist and a short list of the ports/hosts we'll need to open.

One wrinkle: our local calendars show CET switching DST later this month. To avoid confusion, can you put the meeting in UTC and include explicit local times in the invite body (e.g., "13:00 UTC / 09:00 EDT / 14:00 CET / 22:00 SGT")? Also, please include a link to the recording and the test request payloads afterward.

We'll confirm final attendees by Monday morning our time.

Regards,

- Join: Zoom link (provided in invite) — recording will be available after the session
